title: Jofi's Weaponsmith
description: This mod aims to improve combat by adding a variety of new and unique weapons that also have uses as tools
body:
This mod aims to change the way you use your tools by adding 5 **new** weapons 
- The Scythe
- The Halberd
- The Greatsword
- The War Spade
- And The Mattock

along side a new material **Phantom Steal**

Each one of these weapons can be used as there corresponding tools
> e.g. the mattock can be used as a pickaxe

all of these new weapons can be crafted using **Phantom Steal** as a direct replacement of the traditional materials used in crafting basic tools

![mattock crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9f3208e86941eb524f6e45fa95c376cebd059f3.png)

**Phantom Steal** is an alloy of netherite and phantom membrane

![phantom steal crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a209b8e3ad924a9756d4d8282a78e8dc95068c83.png)
